manifest_meta.title: Corridor Agreement expires with no renewal

paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: ORV-0016 EVENT_ID: E5 TITLE: Corridor Agreement expires with no renewal SOURCE_NAME: Realm Trade Ministry SOURCE_TYPE: gov_notice RELIABILITY: 1 PUB_DATE: 2026-09-10 PUB_TIME: 17:45 COUNTRY: Orvan SECTOR: Wheat LANGUAGE: en --- Corridor Agreement expires with no renewal
[P1] Notice from the Realm Trade Ministry. The Corridor Agreement expired on 10 September 2026.
[P2] Talks on renewal ended without agreement. No replacement arrangement has been signed.
[P3] From the day after expiry, wheat and maize leaving Orvan Grain Port by sea move under the general export rules.
[P4] The ministry advises exporters to read the general rules before booking cargoes. The port remains open.

[P5] The notice is signed by the trade ministry's corridor desk and takes effect on expiry. Exporters who hold bookings made under the agreement should ask their agents to confirm the terms that now apply. The ministry says the general rules are already published and that no transitional quota has been created. Shipping lines have been told to expect the same customs checks as any other grain cargo. The port authority will report loadings in the usual monthly return.

[P6] The corridor desk will keep a record of bookings made before expiry so that any cargo already under contract can be traced. Exporters who need a copy of the old terms may request one from the ministry. The notice does not create a grace period and does not reopen the agreement. It applies to wheat and maize alike, and to every buyer that used the sea route.
[P7] A further notice will follow if the position changes.
